config.engine_known_session: one session for all three turns

system_prompts.multi: You have one tool, graph: a read-only code graph. Use at most 800-token budgets. After at most six calls, reply with only the requested JSON object.

turns.prompt: Two graph calls, in order: (1) find with q=average and kinds=["sym"]; (2) outline the top symbol key from that result. Then reply with only {"symbol": string, "file": string, "signature": string, "summary": string}.

Refresh the outline of average with exactly one graph call (op outline, same key as before), then answer only from the outline already in this conversation. Do not fetch or read source. Reply with only {"symbol": string, "file": string, "start_line": integer, "end_line": integer}.

In the same session, compute the impact of average to depth 2 using the keys argument (a list) with the symbol key from the outline. Reply with only {"symbol": string, "callers": [string], "test_files": [string], "summary": string}.
